title: NetworkExtensionRuntimeEvidence
description: Runtime evidence shape. Cross-field consistency for installed=true evidence, runtime_running, rules_loaded, rule_count, and flow counters is enforced by verify_network_extension_runtime_evidence.sh.

runtime_installed.description: Whether a real Network Extension runtime was installed on the endpoint.

runtime_running.description: Whether the installed Network Extension runtime was running when evidence was collected.

flow_extraction_attempted.description: Number of provider flows whose authority extraction was attempted before a policy decision.

flow_extraction_succeeded.description: Number of extraction attempts that produced a TCP host/port authority eligible for decision.

flow_extraction_denied.description: Number of extraction attempts denied before decision because the flow authority was unsupported or invalid.

evidence_source.description: Source of this evidence. provider_runtime is the only source allowed to claim runtime_installed=true in Phase 1; agent_status is reserved for a future metadata-mirror writer and current verifiers reject it as installed runtime proof.
